### [`ram_noise_before_scenes`](../../../../src/scenes/unused_ram_pattern.asm#L6) `$3E80-$3F5E`

*data*

Unused: no code reads these 223 bytes. They are the same page-keyed RAM pattern as $7a80-$7adf (93 of 96 bytes equal) and $c900. RAM that no program wrote before the file was saved.
